CA4200 / CA4242 / CA4800: Forté Café Table with Laminate or DuoForm Top
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-ca4200-ca4242-ca4800-forte-round-top-cafe-table-with-laminated-top-n700160
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/forte-cafe/
Spec sheets: CA4200 / CA4242 / CA4800 Forté Café Table, Laminate Top, CA4242-DF Forté Café Table, DuoForm Top, Forté Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Forté Café Table with Laminate or DuoForm Top – CA4200 / CA4242 / CA4800
Current H1: Norix Forté - Café Table with Laminate or DuoForm Round-Top - Models CA4200 / CA4242 / CA4800
Subtitle: Molded Hourglass Base Café Table with a 42” or 48” Round or 42” Square Top, in Plain, Game, or DuoForm Finishes
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Forté Series Cafeteria Table with Laminated Top
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Forté Café Table pairs a rotationally molded hourglass base with a 42” round, 42” square, or 48” round laminate top, or a 42” square DuoForm top. It is made to go with Forté Guest Chairs in dining areas, dayrooms, and visitation rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities.
The laminate top has a radiused molded edge that is pressure fused to the top, so it stays firmly attached, sanitary, and pick resistant. Embedded T-nuts and Torx head security hardware give a tight steel-to-steel connection between the top and base. To validate the warranty, the table must be bolted down or ballasted with about 150 lbs of dry sand or gravel.
Base: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and TruColor polymer; resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Laminate Top: Premium M3 grade, 45 lb density particle board core between ⅛” hardboard, faced with 0.05” high-pressure laminate, with a 1½” thick edge profile
Molded Edge: Radiused for safety and comfort, and pressure fused to the top so it is firmly attached and pick resistant
DuoForm Top: Fused layers of high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and TruColor polymer, chemically resistant, with a 1½” thick edge profile
Game Top: Optional Titanium Evolve game top on the 42” round, 42” square, and 48” round laminate tables
Top-to-Base Connection: Embedded T-nuts (laminate) or rivnuts (DuoForm) create a steel-to-steel connection
Sizes: 42” round, 42”×42” square, or 48” round, all 30.5”H
Weight: 89 lbs (42” round), 92.5 lbs (42” square), 112 lbs (48” round), or 56 lbs (42” square DuoForm)
Laminate Top Colors: Titanium Evolve, Wild Cherry, Kensington Maple, Asian Sun, Montana Walnut, Palisades Oak, Calcutta Marble, or Black Alicante
DuoForm Top Color: Cove/Twilight
Base Colors: Sienna, Dove, or Raven (the DuoForm table also comes with a Twilight or Cove base)
Static Load Testing: Tested to 1,000 lbs
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for the top; the molded base can also be cleaned with bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 per the manufacturer’s instructions
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty (5-year for the DuoForm top); to validate it, the table must be bolted down or ballasted with 150 lbs of sand
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
CA4200 – 42” Round: Plain top or game top, 89 lbs
CA4242 – 42” Square: Plain top or game top, 92.5 lbs
CA4800 – 48” Round: Plain top or game top, 112 lbs
CA4242-DF – 42” Square DuoForm Top: 56 lbs
Options: Factory ballasting (150 lbs) on all models, bolt-down kit (C011-030) for the laminate tables, and a concealment plate for the DuoForm table (indoor use only)
Installation and Options
Assembly: Assemble following Norix instructions
Ballast: Required to validate the warranty; Norix recommends 150 lbs of dry sand or gravel (up to 200 lbs, not supplied by Norix)
[H2] Applications
The Norix Forté Café Table suits dining areas and dayrooms where residents eat, play games, or meet visitors, and where a table has to stand up to daily use.
Typical applications include:
Dining areas, dayrooms, and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Cafeterias, dayrooms, and visitation rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Waiting rooms and transitional housing
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Transitional Housing Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Forté Furniture
Norix Forté is a designer series of seating and tables that brings comfort and a less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The chairs and molded bases are rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene with Norix TruColor polymer, and many pieces can be ballasted, bolted down, or ganged together.
The Forté series includes:
Guest Chairs: Guest arm and armless chairs, with or without upholstery
Lounge Chairs: Lounge arm and armless chairs on a molded plinth base or a solid hardwood base, with or without upholstery
Café Tables: A 36” round molded table, 42” and 48” round and 42” square laminate tops, and a 42” square DuoForm top, all on a molded hourglass base
Occasional Tables: 27” square laminate-top tables on a molded or wood base, which can be ganged with lounge chairs as intermediate or corner tables
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Forté Furniture" section as the FC600 tab.
PRICE: the 6 laminate variants are 80% of the Norix list prices (CA4200 $1,176 / $1,469.60 of $1,470 / $1,837; CA4242 $1,247.20 / $1,559.20 of $1,559 / $1,949; CA4800 $1,372 / $1,715.20 of $1,715 / $2,144). The DuoForm variant (N700160-07) is $1,168.00 with compare-at $1,450; 80% of $1,450 is $1,160.00. Should it be $1,160.00?
Warranty: the DuoForm spec sheet gives a 5-year warranty, not 10 years like the laminate tables, so I noted it in the warranty bullet.
H1: the current H1 says "Round-Top," but the product also has square tops, so I left it out.
Options: the price list shows factory ballasting (150 lbs) at $164, the bolt-down kit (C011-030) at $60, and the DuoForm concealment plate at $300 (list). They are in the text but are not variants. Would you like any of them as variants?
Laminate colors: the price list pairs each top color with an edge color (for example Palisades Oak with a Graham Cracker edge, Calcutta Marble with an HM Innertone Light edge). I listed the top colors only.
Weights and sizes match the spec sheets and the worksheet (rows 202-208: 89, 92.5, 112, and 56 lbs; 42 / 42 / 30.5 and 48 / 48 / 30.5).
Images: the 7 current images are kept (4 tables, 2 color charts, and the DuoForm table; alt text on 6 is the old product title). Norix also has photos of the 42” square and 48” round laminate tables (600×600). Would you like me to add them as "Norix-Forte-Cafe-Table-CA4242-Square-Palisades-Oak.jpg" and "Norix-Forte-Cafe-Table-CA4800-48-Round-Palisades-Oak.jpg"?
Collections: the table is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture. I added a Transitional Housing Furniture link, since all seven Forté products are in that collection.
Removed: the long old series paragraph and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the new Forté section and the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
